en: If you desire the welfare and happiness of your soul, perform the worship of Nṛhari constantly;
for one who is skilled in adorning a reflection brings beauty to the original object itself.
O bee of the mind, you wander in vain through the tasteless desert-land of worldly existence.
Worship, worship the nectar of the stainless lotus feet of Lakṣmīnarasiṃha. 1.
If the appearance of silver in mother-of-pearl were capable of fulfilling the purpose of a bracelet or similar object,
then this cycle of existence of yours, consisting of suffering, would be capable of bestowing liberation. O bee of a mind, you wander in vain through the tasteless desert-land of worldly existence.
Worship, worship the nectar of the stainless lotus feet of Lakṣmī-Narasiṃha. 2.
Because of its similar form, you mistook the śālmali flower for a land-lotus; do scent and nectar exist here? You wander fruitlessly in this intensely tasteless thing.
O bee of the mind, you wander in vain upon the arid desert-land of saṃsāra, which is devoid of flavor.
Worship, worship the nectar of the sinless lotus feet of Lakṣmī-Narasiṃha! 3.
Considering objects such as garlands, sandalwood, and women to be givers of happiness, you sport among them;
yet surely these enjoyments are like the *gandhaphalī* fruit—they produce suffering immediately thereafter. O bee of a mind, you wander in vain through the tasteless desert-land of saṃsāra.
Worship, worship the nectar of the stainless lotus feet of Lakṣmīnarasiṃha. 4.
I shall speak one word for your benefit; listen, if you desire constant happiness: everything seen in a dream is indeed false, and remember that it is the same upon waking.
O bee of the mind, you wander in vain through the tasteless desert-land of worldly existence.
Worship, worship the nectar of the sinless lotus feet of Lakṣmī-Narasiṃha. 5.
Thus [ends] the work of the venerable Śaṅkara Bhagavat, disciple of the venerable Govinda Bhagavatpūjyapāda, the teacher of the venerable Paramahaṃsa Parivrājakas.
